exposure: blood pressure at last prenatal check-up
cohort: 18,295 normotensive women who delivered at term
finding: New-onset PPHTN was observed in 1.2% of the normotensive women, with women who delivered via cesarean section having the highest risk.
mod_finding: The prevalence of PPHTN was higher in women who delivered via cesarean section than in those who delivered vaginally (7.0% and 1.0%, respectively).
